They cheat

i asked them for 100 percent fill they charged for 100 percent and when i was testing the strength of my part by breaking it i found that it was 50 percent fill. Also they will print single part on multiple printers simultaneously and will then join it. in mine case it was ABS. when i was testing it they all came apart.

i paid 2000 for 8 hours job now all gone because of their cheat.

dont go for these guys

and in case u dont have any choice do check ur part after they print it

Edit:
They contacted me back and offered to reprint it very politely. Will updated the review after the reprint.

Edit 2:

I think the entire episode happened due to some miscommunication. They reprinted the part for me. And i am completely satisfied with them now 👍

Also as mentioned by many others, their staff is very supportive and respondiv.

New perfect part received 😃
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Sorry for the inconveniences as your parts are of bigger size we informed you of printing in two parts and regarding strength it was never mentioned 100% infill still we used 80% infill but your parts design and thickness is less thus it won't have so much strength.
